registry_resolution.rule: Resolve every contract by the exact artifact identity, version, and digest declared by the evidence pack. Resolve verifier-claims.v2 as the ordered union of its pinned base plus its additions.
registry_resolution.duplicate_claim_rule: A duplicate claim name across a registry extension chain is fatal.

exact_action.rule: The supported Permit decision's resource_attributes_json is authoritative. Receipt or display projections are comparison evidence only.
required_bindings: trusted classification when the profile declares it

temporal.dispatch_instant_source: A supported signed runtime-enforcement proof or scope-faithful dispatch-boundary evidence.
temporal.revocation_rule: No effective revocation for the Permit may precede or equal dispatch_at within the supported declared scope.
temporal.mid_flight_rule: A revocation after dispatch does not prove that an already-dispatched external effect was cancelled.

certified_enforcement.binding_rule: Each child names and hashes the exact parent artifact. IDs alone never satisfy binding.
certified_enforcement.active_rule: issued_or_verified_at <= dispatch_at < expires_at and no revocation effective at or before dispatch_at
certified_enforcement.scope_rule: project, semantic, surface, adapter id, adapter version, deployment revision, Permit id, dispatch id, and exact request digest must agree wherever present
certified_enforcement.gate_rule: pre_effect must be true and gate_result must equal the signed decision outcome represented by the claim.

bounded_use.successor_rule: counter_sequence increments by one and previous_transition_digest equals the canonical digest of the immediately preceding supported transition
bounded_use.runtime_atomicity_rule: Runtime enforcement must serialize transitions for the same project_id and permit_id. Schema validity alone does not establish atomicity.
bounded_use.single_use_rule: maximum_uses=1 and exactly one supported transition in a supported scope-faithful counter population
bounded_use.idempotency_rule: One committed idempotency identity binds one Permit, exact request digest, dispatch id, and transition.
bounded_use.replay_rule: A second accepted dispatch for the same Permit and exact request identity disproves replay prevention within the supported scope.

provider_receipts.chain_rule: receipt_sequence starts at one and every successor binds the immediately preceding receipt digest for the same project, Permit, dispatch, provider, operation, semantic, and exact request.
provider_receipts.transport_ceiling: keel_transport_observation may establish rejected or outcome_unknown only.
provider_receipts.http_error_rule: A provider HTTP error or transport error never establishes acceptance.
provider_receipts.acceptance_rule: provider.accepted.v1 requires source-specific authoritative acceptance evidence.
provider_receipts.completion_rule: provider.completed.v1 reports the provider-defined completed state and remains a provider assertion unless independent outcome evidence is separately supported.
provider_receipts.strongest_state_rule: Emit every declared state claim with its own verdict and does_not_establish; do not silently omit a failed declared claim.

privacy.opening_rule: An opening is separate audience-scoped evidence and requires an audit reason.
privacy.erasure_rule: Erasure never rewrites signed authorization bytes. It may erase an opening or emit a signed tombstone while preserving the original commitment.

body.claim_emission_rule: Every claim declared by the evidence pack is emitted exactly once, including failures.
